# Burrow v0.2.4 — Mole Engine & Safer App Care

> **Platform:** macOS 13 Ventura or later · Apple Silicon (`arm64`) only
> **License:** GPL-3.0-only

## What’s new

- Burrow now embeds Mole 1.48.1, the current GPL release, together with its
  corresponding source archive, license and reproducible SHA-256 manifest.
- Application removal uses Mole’s mature residual discovery behind Burrow’s
  typed Rust boundary. The exact plan is shown first, expires automatically and
  is recomputed before confirmation.
- User-facing removal remains recoverable: Mole is forced into Trash mode and
  Burrow never exposes Mole’s permanent-removal flag to the frontend.
- Files are moved with the native macOS Trash API, avoiding fragile Finder
  automation errors.
- Universal applications can be thinned on Apple Silicon using a verified
  working copy. Unsupported App Store and provisioned applications remain
  excluded; the publisher’s original stays recoverable in the Trash.
- Cleanup now reports its actual backend result instead of relying on stale UI
  state.

## Licensing

Burrow is now distributed under GNU GPL version 3 only. Mole is an independent
upstream project and remains fully credited in the README and third-party
notices. Burrow is not the official Mole Mac application.

## Verification

- TypeScript, ESLint, Prettier and production frontend build
- Rust check, clippy with warnings denied, and 89 tests
- Apple Silicon architecture and SHA-256 manifests for bundled resources
- Shell syntax validation for the complete embedded Mole engine
